outputs.name: lexical_record_ids
outputs.constraints: Unique nonempty string identifiers aligned to authoritative snapshot rows; caller establishes snapshot availability.

outputs.name: lexical_delimiter
outputs.constraints: Explicit nonempty identifier field delimiter.

outputs.name: lexical_minimum_parts
outputs.constraints: Integer minimum identifier field count of at least two; all parsed fields must be nonempty.

outputs.name: lexical_primary_part
outputs.constraints: Nonnegative primary-token field index below minimum_parts.

outputs.name: lexical_category_part
outputs.constraints: Nonnegative category field index below minimum_parts.

outputs.name: lexical_reference_parts
outputs.constraints: Nonempty ordered list of field indices below minimum_parts, concatenated to parse the reference time.

outputs.name: lexical_reference_format
outputs.constraints: Explicit pandas strptime format producing nonmissing timezone-naive reference times.

outputs.name: lexical_vocabularies
outputs.constraints: Explicit unique string vocabularies. Entity keys identify attribute columns; identifier keys are primary, numeric and category.

outputs.name: lexical_fallback
outputs.constraints: Explicit nonempty string category fallback; no inference-row category fitting occurs.

outputs.name: lexical_seconds_per_unit
outputs.constraints: Finite positive seconds per output elapsed-time unit; query and reference clocks must agree.

outputs.name: attributes_query_ids
outputs.constraints: Nonempty string query identifiers; order and duplicates are preserved.

outputs.name: attributes_record_ids

outputs.name: attributes_attributes

outputs.name: attributes_vocabularies

outputs.name: attributes_fallback

outputs.name: configuration_observed_at

outputs.name: configuration_states
outputs.constraints: Observation-by-channel string matrix with no missing strings; comma and literal substring semantics are explicit.

outputs.name: configuration_query_times
outputs.constraints: One-dimensional int64 query times on the shared clock; no future observations may contribute. Configuration queries form a regular increasing grid.

outputs.name: configuration_vocabulary
outputs.constraints: Unique ordered nonempty literal tokens supplied by the caller; never learned from query rows.

outputs.name: configuration_suffixes
outputs.constraints: Unique ordered nonempty suffixes defining match priority; no domain suffixes are inferred.

outputs.name: configuration_change_windows
outputs.constraints: Nonempty positive int64 grid-row counts; a full available window is required before its mask is true.

outputs.name: configuration_grid_step
outputs.constraints: Positive integer spacing in the shared clock; query grid must be strictly increasing and regular.

outputs.name: estimates_entity_ids

outputs.name: estimates_observed_at
outputs.constraints: One-dimensional int64 observation times on the shared caller-declared clock, aligned to history rows.

outputs.constraints: One-dimensional int64 estimated event times, aligned to history identifiers; estimate_valid governs missing placeholders.

outputs.name: estimates_estimate_valid
outputs.constraints: Boolean vector aligned to estimate history; false values mask placeholder estimates.

outputs.name: estimates_query_ids
outputs.constraints: Nonempty string query identifiers; order and duplicates are preserved.

outputs.name: estimates_query_times
outputs.constraints: One-dimensional int64 query times on the shared clock; no future observations may contribute. Configuration queries form a regular increasing grid.

outputs.name: estimates_lookbacks
outputs.constraints: Nonempty positive int64 widths on the shared clock. Membership is (query-width, query].

outputs.name: estimates_rounding_step
outputs.constraints: Positive integer observation ceiling-grid spacing on the shared clock; overflow is rejected.

outputs.name: estimates_ticks_per_output_unit

outputs.name: calendar_query_times
outputs.constraints: Nonmissing timezone-naive query timestamps on the declared reference/calendar clock.

outputs.name: calendar_holiday_midnights
outputs.constraints: Sorted unique nonmissing timezone-naive holiday midnights covering the query horizon; caller chooses calendar rules.

outputs.name: forecasts_issued_at
outputs.constraints: One-dimensional int64 forecast issue times; only issues at or before each query are available.

outputs.name: forecasts_valid_at
outputs.constraints: One-dimensional int64 forecast valid times aligned to issue/value rows; issue-valid pairs must be unique.

outputs.name: forecasts_values
outputs.constraints: Aligned forecast-row by field float64 matrix; NaN means missing and infinity is rejected. Fields use explicit linear scalar units; circular statistics are not inferred.

outputs.name: forecasts_query_times
outputs.constraints: One-dimensional int64 query times on the shared clock; no future observations may contribute. Configuration queries form a regular increasing grid.

outputs.name: forecasts_history_window
outputs.constraints: Positive integer clock width; historical issue membership is (query-width, query].

outputs.name: forecasts_lead_bands
outputs.constraints: Nonempty list of (lower, upper] integer lead bounds; lower=None means unbounded below.

outputs.name: forecasts_contrast_leads
outputs.constraints: Int64 matrix with two lead values per row; subtract right forecast from left within the latest issue only.

outputs.name: forecasts_revision_lags
outputs.constraints: Nonempty positive int64 issue-row lags for the same valid time; missing revisions remain unavailable.

outputs.name: counts_observed_at
outputs.constraints: One-dimensional int64 observation times on the shared caller-declared clock, aligned to history rows.

outputs.name: counts_actual_at
outputs.constraints: Int64 actual-event times on the observation clock; events cannot count before both actual and observed time. Shape is event rows by channels; masked placeholders are ignored.

outputs.name: counts_countable
outputs.constraints: Boolean event-by-channel mask aligned to actual_at; false entries exclude missing identities, categories or actual times.

outputs.name: counts_query_times
outputs.constraints: One-dimensional int64 query times on the shared clock; no future observations may contribute. Configuration queries form a regular increasing grid.

outputs.name: counts_lookbacks
outputs.constraints: Nonempty positive int64 widths on the shared clock. Membership is (query-width, query].

inputs.name: model
inputs.constraints: Fitted native model supporting ordered feature names and single-thread feature importance.

outputs.name: names
outputs.constraints: Ordered feature names from the fitted model.

outputs.name: values
outputs.constraints: Aligned one-dimensional native feature importance weights; normalization is separate.

inputs.name: names
inputs.constraints: Unique nonempty ordered string feature names.

inputs.name: values
inputs.constraints: Aligned finite nonnegative weights with strictly positive total.

outputs.name: importance
outputs.constraints: Columns feature and importance; weights sum to one, descending order, original positional indices retained.

inputs.name: value
inputs.constraints: Materialized branch output, with type and units established by the branch contract.

inputs.name: receive
inputs.constraints: Controller-owned callable invoked once with value; never deserialized from model state.

outputs.name: result
outputs.constraints: Same branch value after delivery to its controller.

inputs.name: primary
inputs.constraints: Complete hash-bound executable graph descriptor with declared output node and port.

inputs.name: baseline
inputs.constraints: Complete hash-bound fallback graph descriptor; validated even for empty queries.

inputs.name: inputs
inputs.constraints: Explicit runtime branch inputs; no discovery of datasets or models.

inputs.name: count
inputs.constraints: Nonnegative positional row count shared by both branch outputs.

inputs.name: constant
inputs.constraints: Finite scalar last-resort output in the same caller-declared units as both branches.

outputs.name: values
outputs.constraints: Finite aligned real vector. Primary then baseline execute lazily and sequentially; ordinary exceptions fall through. Empty returns float64 without executing branches.

outputs.name: route
outputs.constraints: Exactly primary, baseline, constant or empty. Malformed graph descriptors and process-control exceptions propagate.

inputs.name: tables
inputs.constraints: Nonempty ordered DataFrames with unique columns; caller establishes availability.

inputs.name: labels
inputs.constraints: Aligned unique nonempty string population labels.

inputs.name: columns
inputs.constraints: Aligned nonempty unique ordered column-name lists; each includes order_column. Different selections form a union with pandas missing values.

inputs.name: label_column
inputs.constraints: New nonempty label column absent from all tables and distinct from order_column.

inputs.name: order_column
inputs.constraints: Present in each selected schema; values share comparable type and units.

outputs.name: table
outputs.constraints: Owned selected/labeled concatenation sorted by order_column using quicksort with reset index. Equal-key order is not guaranteed.

inputs.name: vectors
inputs.constraints: Nonempty ordered list of finite real vectors with identical shape and physical units.

outputs.name: values
outputs.constraints: Owned positional arithmetic mean using caller order; rejects nonfinite sum or incompatible shapes.

inputs.name: model
inputs.constraints: Fitted native regressor with ordered feature_names_ and predict(thread_count=1).

inputs.name: frame
inputs.constraints: Feature names and order exactly match the fitted schema; caller supplies training-compatible units, encodings and availability.

outputs.name: values
outputs.constraints: Owned finite scalar predictions aligned to frame rows in model target units.

inputs.name: models
inputs.constraints: Unique nonempty string model names mapped to nonmissing opaque objects.

inputs.name: population_bindings
inputs.constraints: Explicit named populations mapped to nonempty local slot-to-model-name mappings; no implicit normalization.

inputs.name: shared_bindings
inputs.constraints: Shared slot-to-model-name mapping disjoint from local slots. All named models must be referenced; shared slots require populations.

outputs.name: bank
outputs.constraints: Owned population/slot containers preserving model identities and aliases; backend validation and serialization are separate.

inputs.name: x_train
inputs.constraints: Nonempty unique ordered training feature schema with fixed units and categorical encodings.

inputs.name: y_train
inputs.constraints: Finite positional target vector; Series index must equal training frame index.

inputs.name: x_valid
inputs.constraints: Nonempty validation frame with identical ordered feature schema and units.

inputs.name: y_valid
inputs.constraints: Finite aligned validation targets in training target units, with matching row index.

inputs.name: categorical_indices
inputs.constraints: Unique integer indices within the feature schema.

inputs.name: parameters
inputs.constraints: Explicit CatBoost CPU constructor settings. thread_count, allow_writing_files, train_dir, devices and device_config overrides are rejected.

inputs.name: early_stopping_rounds
inputs.constraints: Strictly positive integer patience; validation selects the best model.

outputs.name: model
outputs.constraints: Fitted CatBoostRegressor with one native thread, no backend file writes, explicit validation and best-model selection. Empirical performance is not guaranteed.

inputs.name: frame
inputs.constraints: Named feature table with nonempty unique columns; positional row alignment is authoritative.

inputs.name: targets
inputs.constraints: Aligned scalar target vector, finite on eligible rows, in caller-declared units.

inputs.name: times
inputs.constraints: Aligned nonmissing timezone-naive times on one declared clock.

inputs.name: eligible
inputs.constraints: Boolean vector aligned to frame; explicitly determines eligible training and validation rows.

inputs.name: cutoff
inputs.constraints: Nonmissing timezone-naive pandas-compatible timestamp on the times clock. Equality belongs to validation.

inputs.name: offsets
inputs.constraints: Aligned target-unit offsets, finite on eligible rows; subtracted before fitting.

inputs.name: categorical_columns
inputs.constraints: Unique explicit names in frame; categorical columns are not inferred from domain naming.

outputs.name: x_train
outputs.constraints: Owned eligible rows strictly before cutoff, preserving original order and index.

outputs.name: y_train
outputs.constraints: Aligned float64 target minus offset, retaining frame index.

outputs.name: x_valid
outputs.constraints: Owned eligible rows at or after cutoff; both splits must be nonempty.

outputs.name: y_valid
outputs.constraints: Aligned float64 validation target minus offset in target units.

outputs.name: categorical_indices
outputs.constraints: Ordered categorical column positions in the unchanged feature schema.

inputs.name: bank

inputs.name: state

inputs.name: state
